claim: SoWLoader is a hand-written steam_api64.dll proxy that forwards all 796 Steam exports to a renamed steam_api64_org.dll and starts a worker thread from DllMain.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN: repo records no game version, Steam buildid, exe hash or build check; it only states a ~112 MB x64 Steam exe with SteamStub v3.1 + Denuvo (docs/reverse-engineering.md:12,21-29). Our exe is 117732784 bytes (~112.3 MiB), consistent but not proof of 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001. The proxy mechanism itself is build-agnostic as long as steam_api64.dll export set matches.
verification_method: Static read of repo source. Against our build: compare the export list of our install's steam_api64.dll with the 796 names in exports_forward.h (static PE export dump, no execution).
limitations: Repo-only; not executed. Export count is tied to the steam_api64.dll version the author had.
next_experiment: Dump our steam_api64.dll export table (pefile, read-only) and diff against exports_forward.h names.
